# CIS interface content

For human-facing text, use `.github/skills/cis-ux-writing/SKILL.md` and the shared content standard. Read the actual state and action handler before changing labels or messages.

Explain the current situation, its effect, and the next supported action. Preserve the difference between preview, save, review, approval, and execution. Keep material blockers and action consequences visible; make safe diagnostic detail available separately.

Keep stable command IDs, state values, permissions, and confirmation behavior unchanged for copy-only work. Flag missing state information or recovery actions as functional gaps. Do not invent them in prose. Preserve escaping and accessible names, and test the wording in a narrow editor pane.
